svg.text: PLACEHOLDER · characters: aria, bram, sylfie · seed: None

text.tspan: Aria casting chaotic combined spell — swirling mix of pink
flower petals, blue ice crystals, golden light ribbons, dark ink
tendrils all spiraling together from her wand. Grumblebeast
caught in center, tangled in glowing vines, lifting gently off
ground. Aria's face: fierce joy, tongue out, lavender streak
blazing. Bram and Sylfie shielding eyes from sparkles. Explosion
of color in dreamy pastel palette. Characters: ARIA: human girl
7-8, small stocky build, warm beige skin with nose freckles,
messy chin-length chestnut bob (#5d4037) with single lavender
oversized blush-pink wizard robe (#f4c2c2) rolled sleeves, mint-
green satchel (#a8e6cf), scuffed brown boots (#4e342e), golden
friendship bracelets (#ffd93d) both wrists, ink-smudged fingers,
singed robe hem, tiny star scar on chin, determined concentrated
